producer: GAVO DaCHS 2.12.2 (Python), per INFO server_software, DataLink links response

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Publisher data set id; this is an identifier for the dataset in question and can be used to retrieve the data.

columns.name: access_url
columns.description: URL to retrieve the data or access the service.

columns.name: service_def
columns.description: Identifier for the type of service if accessURL refers to a service.

columns.name: error_message
columns.description: If accessURL is empty, this column gives the reason why.

columns.name: semantics
columns.description: What kind of data is linked here? Standard identifiers here include science, calibration, preview, info, auxiliary

columns.name: content_type
columns.description: Media type for the data returned.

columns.name: content_length
columns.description: Size of the resource at access_url.

columns.name: local_semantics
columns.description: An identifier that allows clients to associate rows from different datalink documents on the same service with each other.

columns.name: content_qualifier
columns.description: An identifier for the sort of content obtained by dereferencing the link (e.g., spectrum, image, or cube). Terms here are relative to http://www.ivoa.net/rdf/product-type

rows: Full data cube this spectrum was taken from

The Calar Alto Legacy Integral Field Area (CALIFA) survey provides
spatially resolved spectroscopic information for 667 galaxies, mainly
within the local universe (0.005 < z < 0.03).

CALIFA data was obtained using the PPAK integral field unit (IFU), with a
hexagonal field-of-view of 1.3 square arcmin, with a 100% covering factor
by adopting a three-pointing dithering scheme.  has been taken in two
setups: V500 (6 ? bin size, 646 galaxies) and V1200 (2.3 ? bin size, 484
galaxies).  A final product ("COMBO") combining both data sets, covering
3700-7500 ? at 6 ? bin size, is made availble for 484 galaxies.

CALIFA is a legacy survey, intended for the community.  This is the (final)
Data Release 3.  This is the VO/TAP publication with a simple web
interface on top.  See http://califa.caha.es/ for the upstream
site.
notes:
Served as application/x-votable+xml;content=datalink.
